name: Michigan Boat Launch Finder decision-usability benchmark

baseline.note: Pre-correction branch had map/card synchronization and a real visible photo, but legacy coordinates were treated as exact, condition data was mostly raw, personas were not served, and there was no alternative-launch decision layer.

fatalFailures: legacy coordinates presented as verified without source
approximate coordinates used for turn-by-turn routing
map and launch card use different records
raw NDBC data presented as ramp-local or safety truth
synthetic launch image presented as a real place
